finite difference: a numerical discretization technique for differential equations
crank-nicolson: an implicit second-order numerically stable scheme
boundary condition: a physical constraint imposed on the solution manifold
convergence: the asymptotic tendency of a sequence toward its limit
stability: the property guaranteeing bounded error propagation
truncation error: the residual discrepancy between continuous and discrete operators
eigenvalue: a characteristic scalar of a linear transformation
discretization: the process of projecting continuous equations onto discrete grids
loss function: an objective metric quantifying model estimation discrepancy
cross-validation: a resampling protocol assessing model generalization bounds
hyperparameter: an external configuration variable tuned outside model optimization
regularization: a penalty term constraining model parameter complexity
attention mechanism: a dynamically weighted contextual aggregation layer
